name: Miss Vere (Disgraced)
appearance: The same fashionable beauty undone — pale and hollow-eyed, her fine dress now a reproach, the room's regard turned to whispers.
definition: Miss Vere after scandal has done its work: the proud beauty cast out of the society she once ruled. Stripped of her standing, she is by turns brittle, defiant, and desperate — a cautionary shadow of who she was.
voice: Brittle and defensive, old hauteur cracking into bitterness or pleading; pride and shame at war in every line.
